description: Western secondary progressions — "a day for a year" technique. Shows how natal chart evolves over time. Progressed Moon moves ~1 degree/month (changes sign every 2.5 years). Progressed Sun moves ~1 degree/year. "chart" returns full progressed chart. "positions" returns progressed planets. "aspects" returns progressed-to-natal aspects. Tropical zodiac. Cost: $0.092/call.

datetime.description: Birth date and time in ISO 8601 format, e.g. "1990-06-15T14:30:00". Required for all chart calculations.

latitude.description: Birth location latitude (-90 to 90). Polar latitudes >66.5 are rejected (house calculations unreliable).

progressionDate.description: Date to progress to (ISO 8601). Defaults to now.

timezone.description: Timezone as UTC offset "+05:30" or IANA "Asia/Kolkata". UTC offsets preferred.

type.description: chart=full progressed chart (default). positions=progressed planets. aspects=progressed-to-natal aspects.

name: vedika_western_progressions
